description: This file implements a validation pipeline behavior in a C# application, likely using MediatR for request handling and FluentValidation for input validation. It defines a class that intercepts requests to validate them before passing control to the next handler.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior that validates incoming requests using a collection of validators before proceeding.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the request by validating it using all validators and either throwing an exception on failure or calling the next handler.
